Q: Why does is.na(NULL) returns logical(0) and not FALSE? A:

Internally in do_isna (see coerce.c~L2260), the output is allocated with allocVector(LGLSXP, n) where n = xlength(x). Since NULL (R_NilValue) has length 0, you get logical(0) back: zero elements in, zero elements out.

Your is.null(x) | is.na(x) fails because | is vectorized with recycling: length-1 (TRUE) combined with length-0 (logical(0)) yields length-0.

I'd suggest using anyNA() and ||:

if (is.null(x) || anyNA(x)) {
  ...
  ...
  ...
}

anyNA() always returns a scalar. In case of NULL where input length is 0, it returns FALSE (see coerce.c~L2370). The || avoids evaluating anyNA(x) if is.null(x) is already TRUE.

Q: Create a .gitignore file after creating the repository and publish .idea file? A:

You can create your .gitignore-file whenever you want. In several IDE's, if you create and start a new program, by default it already has a .gitignore-file where you can add all files, which should not be published after git push on your remote repository.

If the repository exists, commits and pushes have been executed include the .idea-files, you must untrack the .idea-files.

With following command, you can removes the file from the repository without physically deleting:

git rm --cache directory/to/.idea

After this command, ignoring should work properly when you commit and push this changes:

git commit -m "add gitignore file"

git push

Q: Drupal 6 CCK: export/import content types A:

Believe the issue how the node type creation process is conducted with contrib modules.

The workaround is...

  1. Create a new content type (just the name will do.)
  2. Run your import (with the proper machine name) over the top of this stub content type.

Certainly worked for me with a big monster node type.
